title: Boys rejected by girls...:Madras HC upholds conviction of man who killed woman inside college
description: The Madras High Court recently upheld the conviction and life sentence imposed on a man for killing a woman engineering student inside her classroom after she refused to continue her relationship with him. (Udaykumar v. State)A Bench of Justices N Anand Venkatesh and K K Ramakrishnan dismissed the appeal filed by Udayakumar, who had been convicted by a Karur court for murdering Sonali, a third-year civil engineering student at Karur College of Engineering.“This is an unfortunate case where a gir
